1. @SciTechera  
BIG BREAKTHROUGH:  
🚨 Claude just autonomously designed 354 protein binders that worked in the lab. 🤯  
"Anthropic tested Claude on de novo protein design, asking its AI agents to create novel protein minibinders for 16 biological targets, including PD-L1, VEGF-A, EGFR, TNFα and TREM2."  
"Across 15 experimentally evaluated targets, Claude generated 1,320 protein designs, with 354 experimentally confirmed binders."  
"The AI successfully produced binders against 14 of the 15 targets tested, achieving overall hit rates of 22.6% to 35.1%."  
"That's roughly 2–3× higher than the 10–15% hit rates Anthropic reports as typical for current de novo protein-binder campaigns."  
"Claude wasn't simply generating protein sequences. It autonomously orchestrated specialized protein-design, sequence-design and protein-folding models, iteratively optimized candidates, filtered them computationally, and selected designs for real-world laboratory testing."  
"Against RBX1, Claude achieved a 40% hit rate, compared with just 3.7% in a previous protein-design competition involving 245 submitted designs." 👀  
"Claude also produced high-affinity binders against at least 6 targets, with some matching or exceeding previously reported best affinities. Anthropic defines high affinity here as Kᴅ < 10 nM."  
"Adaptyv Bio and Twist Bioscience physically produced and tested the AI-generated proteins, turning Claude's computational designs into real molecules."  
"The bigger breakthrough is the workflow:  
AI designs proteins → computational optimization → laboratory synthesis and testing."  
AI is moving from predicting biology to engineering it. ♥️

10. @MagicForestLand  
GMARMS! 🦫  
This is the kind of crypto story we love.  
@TeamMarmot, a research project that has been studying yellow bellied marmots in Colorado for 60 years, was at risk of losing its funding.  
The Solana community stepped in, created OnlyMarms token, and directed the trading fees to the researchers.  
In just two weeks, it generated more than $88,000, helping push the total raised past $100K and giving the research at least another year to continue.  
There’s something really special about this side of Solana.  
When people see something worth protecting, they don’t just share it. Sometimes they build around it, rally a community and find entirely new ways to fund it.  
We’ve experienced a little bit of that magic ourselves.  
Earlier this year, members of the Solana community surprised us with an initiative of their own to support Magic Forest, directing creator fees as donations to our nonprofit. A very special thank you again to @whashywash @MageArez @swebbie3 and everyone who made it happen. We haven’t forgotten it.  
So seeing the same spirit now helping keep a 60 year wildlife study alive makes us incredibly happy.  
Huge love to everyone behind @OnlyMarmsRMBL and to the Solana community for showing once again what crypto communities can do when they rally around something worth protecting. 💚
